leuven.name: Leuven Town Hall
leuven.slogan: A stone lace jewel box with a saint in every niche.
leuven.line: Its 236 statues are Victorian replacements: the Gothic niches are original, but the statues only date from after 1850.

tervuren.name: AfricaMuseum
tervuren.slogan: A neoclassical palace in the forest, rethinking its own story.
tervuren.line: Born from the 1897 colonial exhibition, it reopened as the AfricaMuseum on 9 December 2018 after five years of renovation.

laatsteavondmaal.name: Dirk Bouts' Last Supper
laatsteavondmaal.slogan: Christ's table, painted in perfect perspective in Sint-Pieterskerk.
laatsteavondmaal.line: Dirk Bouts painted the Altarpiece of the Holy Sacrament between 1464 and 1468; the church tower was never finished.

grootbegijnhof.name: Groot Begijnhof
grootbegijnhof.slogan: Brick lanes and Dijle footbridges, now a university's quiet quarter.
grootbegijnhof.line: KU Leuven bought the crumbling beguinage in 1962 and restored it as housing; UNESCO listed it in 1998.

scherpenheuvelbasiliek.name: Scherpenheuvel Basilica
scherpenheuvelbasiliek.slogan: A pilgrim town laid out as a seven-pointed star.
scherpenheuvelbasiliek.line: The foundation stone was laid in 1609 by Archdukes Albert and Isabella; the basilica rests on seven columns.
